summary: SF_DRYWALL_CEILING_NC_PRIME passes all critical doctrine checks. Generated from brief with full brief compliance. All PaintScope keys verified, all protection zones valid, all adjacency declarations complete. Three warnings flagged — two inherited from wall prime sibling pattern, one brief dimension discrepancy for human review.

issues.description: Masking tasks TSK_CEIL_MASK_ADJACENT and TSK_CEIL_MASK_ADJACENT_SPRAY are listed in adjacency_declarations.affected_tasks for trim_crown but lack adjacency_metadata. They have protection_metadata instead.
issues.suggested_fix: This matches the wall prime pattern where masking tasks are classified as protection, not edge application. Consistent with sibling spec. No action required unless doctrine changes.

issues.description: Brief Section 3 specified only 2 config dimensions but spec has 4. Human decided to keep all 4 dimensions (application_method, ceiling_height, drywall_finish_level, surface_texture).
issues.resolution: Keep all 4 config dimensions. They affect coverage and production rates. Brief should be updated to reflect.

issues.description: TSK_CEIL_LIGHT_SAND_PRIME placement — human decided light sand belongs in finish spec prep phase, not prime spec. Removed from both ceiling and wall prime specs.
issues.resolution: Removed. Light sand is prep phase of SF_DRYWALL_CEILING_NC_FINISH (and SF_DRYWALL_WALL_NC_FINISH).

human_feedback.notes: Initial draft — human review gate pending. Status is draft, review_required is true. Cannot approve as FINAL until human feedback is captured.

review_notes: This is a clean ceiling prime spec that mirrors the wall prime sibling with appropriate ceiling-specific adjustments. The overhead fatigue factor (15-25%) is applied consistently across all production rates. The edge key resolution (using PS_EDGE_LF.TO_WALL for the same physical edge) is sound. Three items need human attention: (1) config dimension discrepancy with brief, (2) light sand task placement, (3) production rate calibration ranges. All are WARN-level, no blockers.
